pages.title: Mythos Pickaxe
pages.text: An ancient tool reforged through bound Mythos. The Mythos Pickaxe is a powerful mining tool infused with ambient Mythos energy. Unlike conventional tools, it draws from the Mythos reserves
Consumes 8 Mythos per block mined. If no Mythos is available, the pickaxe cannot mine. Will passively refill from items like Mythos Pools.
